title: Amazon Was Almost Called Cadabra
description:
Amazon started in 1994 as an online bookstore, and its first name was Cadabra. Here's why Jeff Bezos changed it.

Follow MarketOpsTips for the stories behind big brands.

#business #amazon #shorts

beats.say: In 1994, Jeff Bezos started it as an online bookstore, working out of a garage near Seattle.
His first name idea was Cadabra, as in abracadabra. Then a lawyer heard it on the phone as cadaver.
That was the end of Cadabra.
He picked Amazon instead, after the world's largest river. Something huge, just like he wanted the store to be.
Would you have shopped at Cadabra?
